descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使自制纸菜单，碗旁那只悬空小手没有碰到任何东西。
descriptions.en: My handmade menu includes the hovering hand that never touched the soup bowl.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 这张自制纸菜单记着先塌下面皮、再碰到奶酪的两口。
descriptions.en: My paper menu recalls two bites: one to settle the pastry, another to find the cheese.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 我用自己的纸折出翘起的两角，记着休息区那个关于飞行的问题。
descriptions.en: My two-corner paper fold recalls a question about flying at the rest area.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使将纸的两面并排露出，记着颜色没对上的那双手套。
descriptions.en: I folded both sides of the paper into view for the gloves that failed to match.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 我给两片纸角加了小扣口，合起来像已经整理好的外套。
descriptions.en: Little slots hold the corners of my original paper card together like a neatly tied coat.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使剪掉纸签一角，给想看花的眼睛留了位置，不复制园内标识。
descriptions.en: I cut a corner from my tab to leave a view for another pair of eyes, without copying garden signs.
